new_libraries.name: RV565
new_libraries.author: Ayushman Bhattacharya
new_libraries.sentence: Frame-independent RGB565 video on ESP32-S3 and RP2350 SPI displays, with a dual-core decode and DMA pipeline.
new_libraries.paragraph: Plays RV565 clips (independently zlib-compressed RGB565 frames) on ST7789 panels, seeks in O(1), and predicts from the file alone whether a clip will play without missed frames. Measured at 24 FPS with zero misses on the ESP32-S3 (arXiv:2610.35935); the RP2350 port is experimental.

new_libraries.name: TinyLED
new_libraries.author: SerhiiLe
new_libraries.sentence: Ultra-lightweight WS2812B LED library for ESP8266, ESP32, and RP2040 with FastLED drop-in API.
new_libraries.paragraph: Super compact (~2.2 KB Flash vs ~110 KB FastLED), zero dynamic RAM allocations. Hardware RMT for ESP32/S2/S3/C3/C6, hardware PIO for RP2040/RP2350, and cycle-accurate IRAM bitbang for ESP8266. Full FastLED API compatibility for clock and matrix projects.
